title: Cheesy Zesty Wrap
description: A simple yet flavorful wrap filled with melted cheese and zesty goodness.
instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Lay the monsoon wrap flat and spread the zesty spread evenly.
Sprinkle the shredded dutch cheese over the zesty spread.
Fold the wrap in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
Flip the wrap and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
